questions: What are the exact authoring names and consumers of cloth-definition offsets +0x54 and +0x58?
Does the one definition-count-two installed model use those seed tables for adjacent LOD state transfer?
What exact fixed-step target selects the observed cap of 30 cloth substeps?

findings.fact: TStudioRender012 slots +0x98 through +0xa8 create, reset, configure, and advance persistent cloth instances.
findings.consequence: Garment state is renderer-owned and persists across draws independently of the client's bone-chain list.

findings.fact: StudioModel +200/+204 select cloth definitions, +208/+212 authored capsules, and +216/+220 authored spheres.
findings.evidence: 0x2c003ad0 resolves the definition table; 0x2c014a00 transforms 36-byte two-endpoint records and 20-byte one-center records through the current bone palette before cloth simulation.
findings.consequence: Collision and solver topology are authored in the MDL image, not inferred from garment material names or the PHY file.

findings.fact: StudioMesh +48/+52/+56 are per-render-vertex cloth selector, simulated position/normal, and tangent-output maps.
findings.evidence: Representative generated routines 0x2c023590 and 0x2c03a2e0 read the three arrays; selector 0xff takes ordinary palette skinning and other selectors substitute simulated output.
findings.consequence: Valid biped weights coexist with cloth and describe fallback/attachment input rather than the final free-surface position.

findings.fact: The cloth definition carries pinned and dynamic particles, general distance and compression-only constraints, collision triangles, and tangent-space reconstruction tables.
findings.evidence: 0x2c003ad0 and 0x2c001850 construct state; 0x2c002d90 always solves its constraint set, while 0x2c0030a0 acts only when current length squared is below rest length squared; 0x2c002500 consumes the edge/contribution tables.
findings.consequence: The solver is sufficiently decoded for an engine-independent numerical implementation without inventing a garment lattice.

findings.fact: Each cloth advance integrates inertia, gravity and wind, then solves distance, compression-only, distance again, and collision for each substep.
findings.evidence: 0x2c001e50 orchestrates 0x2c002a30, 0x2c002d90, 0x2c0030a0 and 0x2c0031a0; elapsed-time subdivision is capped at 30 steps.
findings.consequence: Gravity fall, inertial swing, wind response and body collision are one deterministic renderer solve.

findings.fact: Pinned particles are refreshed from source vertices skinned through the current bone palette before free particles advance.
findings.evidence: The definition +0x10 uint16 source-vertex list feeds the palette-skinning copy in the live-object update path.
findings.consequence: Animation drives the garment attachment boundary while simulation drives the hanging region.

functions.label: advance_cloth_instances
functions.role: TStudioRender012 slot +0xa8; advances timing and retires stale live objects.

functions.label: set_cloth_environment
functions.role: TStudioRender012 slot +0xa4; copies wind and dynamic collision records into renderer state.

functions.label: create_cloth_handle
functions.role: TStudioRender012 slot +0x98; allocates a per-engine-instance cloth handle.

functions.label: reset_cloth_handle
functions.role: TStudioRender012 slot +0xa0; resets every live cloth object owned by one handle.

functions.label: get_or_create_cloth_object
functions.role: Looks up persistent cloth state by instance handle, model variant, and definition, creating it on demand.

functions.label: cloth_object_constructor
functions.role: Initializes the 0x6c-byte object and its double-buffered particle storage.

functions.label: cloth_simulation_advance
functions.role: Subdivides elapsed time and orchestrates integration, constraint solves, collision, and output refresh.

functions.label: regenerate_cloth_tangent_space
functions.role: Rebuilds normals and tangent outputs from simulated geometry and authored edge/contribution tables.

functions.label: integrate_cloth_particles
functions.role: Advances double-buffered positions with inertia, gravity and wind.

functions.label: solve_cloth_distance_constraints
functions.role: Applies the general distance constraint set.

functions.label: solve_cloth_compression_constraints
functions.role: Applies its set only when a particle pair is shorter than authored rest length.

functions.label: project_cloth_collisions
functions.role: Projects cloth collision triangles against authored capsules/spheres and dynamic records.

functions.label: reset_cloth_object
functions.role: Marks one persistent object for lazy state reinitialization.

functions.label: create_live_cloth_object
functions.role: Resolves authored definition data, initializes runtime buffers, and links the live object.

functions.label: build_authored_cloth_collision
functions.role: Transforms StudioModel capsule and sphere records through the current bone palette.

functions.label: mapped_cloth_vertex_entry
functions.role: Representative generated specialization substituting simulated position and normal.

functions.label: mapped_cloth_vertex_tangent_entry
functions.role: Representative generated specialization also reading the simulated tangent map.
